lines: 蓝星。
魔都市一中的操场上。
一座巨大的法阵勾勒在操场的中间，工作人员正在有条不紊的进行着布置。
苏业眼中带着复杂的看着那巨大的法阵，整个高三的学生都汇聚到了操场上，不仅仅是一中，整个帝国或者说整个世界在这一天都在进行着同样一件事情。
领主日！
这是一个领主的世界，这一天全世界十八岁的少男少女，当然也有可能是男人少妇会在这一天通过法阵，进入永恒世界成为一名新手领主。
“说好的金手指呢？说好的系统呢？特么的都是骗人的。”苏业看着那巨大的法阵，作为孤儿，而且还是重生者。
重生到这个世界十八年的时间，虽然已经有了双buff在身，但是终究还缺点什么，比如说暗恋自己的校花，没有血亲的妹妹，姐姐，小姨。
就一普通人除了有前世的记忆之外，emmm，就没有其他的了，当然帅气是必不可少的事情。
一道女声响起，苏业的班主任汤兰兰，拍了拍手开始最后的嘱咐。
“好了，各位回神了，法阵马上就要修建好了，现在我交代你们一些事情，一定要记好，进入永恒世界一点，不管如何都要度过三十天的新手领主时期。”
“这段时间是你们发展最好的时间，全力发展自己的领地和兵种，记住无论如何都要渡过这三十天，哪怕是成为菜农领主，也比变成普通人强。”
“多的我也不说了，这三年的时间你们已经学习了很多关于领主的东西，记住量力而行，不要贪，更不要冲动，兵种是领主力量，但是领地才是领主的根基，记住了。”
“好的，老师！！”x45
汤兰兰压了压手，叹息了一声看向那构建而成的法阵。
第一批学生在法阵之中化为光芒消失在了法阵之中，紧接着第二批，第三批，第四批，很快就轮到了苏业所在的班级。
苏业踏上了传送阵，随着光芒升起，他的身影消失在了传送阵中。
【叮：欢迎来到永恒世界，这里是诸神的竞技场，亦是诸神的乐园，是成神，还是毁灭，皆由你来抉择！】
【叮：检测到领主第一次进入永恒世界，辅助功能开启！】
【叮：面板系统正在加载......】
【叮：交易系统封锁，为期三十天！】
【叮：聊天系统正在加载......】
【叮：天赋已觉醒：至高主宰（唯一！）】
【叮：新手礼包已发放领主物品空间，请查收】
苏业站在一块草地之上，接收着来自于系统的信息，系统并非是系统，而是来自于永恒世界的意志所化，这也不是游戏，可是残酷的领主世界。
苏业睁开眼睛，看着面前的草地：“运气不错，新手领地居然是草地，最起码不是水泽或者沙漠。”
新手领主的初始领地都是随机的，也就是说全看运气，当然不可能出现死地之类的存在，只不过很难就是了。
当然也有运气很好的，新手领地就是森林，或者矿脉之类的，这属于天选之子去了，这样的存在初始就比别人发展快。
content_en:
Blue Star.
On the playground of No. 1 Middle School in Magic City.
A huge magic circle is outlined in the middle of the playground, and the staff are decorating it in an orderly manner.
Su Ye looked at the huge magic circle with complicated eyes. The entire senior high school students gathered on the playground. Not only the No. 1 Middle School, but the entire empire or the entire world were doing the same thing on this day.
Lord's Day!
This is a world of lords. On this day, eighteen-year-old boys and girls all over the world, and of course, men and women, will pass through the magic circle and enter the eternal world to become novice lords.
"Where's the golden finger that was promised? Where's the system that was promised? It's all a lie." Su Ye looked at the huge magic circle. As an orphan, he was also a reborn person.
It has been eighteen years since I was reborn in this world. Although I already have two buffs, there are still some shortcomings, such as a crush on my school beauty, a sister who is not a blood relative, an elder sister, and an aunt.
An ordinary person has nothing but memories of past lives, emmm, and of course being handsome is an essential thing.
A female voice sounded. Tang Lanlan, Su ye's class teacher, clapped her hands and began to give her final instructions.
"Okay, everyone has come to their senses. The magic circle will be built soon. Now I will tell you some things. You must remember them well. After entering the eternal world, you must spend the thirty days of the novice lord period no matter what."
"This period is the best time for you to develop. Try your best to develop your territory and troops. Remember that you have to get through these thirty days no matter what. Even becoming a vegetable farmer lord is better than becoming an ordinary person."
"I won't tell you more. You have learned a lot about lords in the past three years. Remember to act according to your ability, don't be greedy, and don't be impulsive. Soldiers are the strength of the lord, but the territory is the foundation of the lord. Remember."
"Okay, teacher!!" x45
Tang Lanlan pressed her hands, sighed and looked at the constructed magic circle.
The first batch of students turned into light and disappeared into the magic circle, followed by the second batch, the third batch, the fourth batch, and soon it was the turn of Su Ye's class.
Su ye stepped onto the teleportation array, and as the light rose, his figure disappeared into the teleportation array.
.......Lord's dividing line......
[Ding: Welcome to the eternal world. This is the arena of the gods and the paradise of the gods. It is up to you to decide whether to become a god or to be destroyed! 】
[Ding: It is detected that the lord enters the eternal world for the first time, and the auxiliary function is turned on! 】
[Ding: The panel system is loading...]
[Ding: The trading system is blocked for thirty days! 】
[Ding: The chat system is loading...]
.............
[Ding: The talent has been awakened: the supreme master (the only one!)]
[Ding: The novice gift pack has been issued with lord item space, please check it]
Su ye stood on a piece of grass, receiving information from the system. The system was not a system, but the will of the eternal world. This was not a game, but a cruel world of lords.
Su Ye opened his eyes and looked at the grass in front of him: "Luckily, the novice's territory is actually grass, at least not a swamp or a desert."
The initial territories of novice lords are all random, which means it all depends on luck. Of course, it is impossible for a dead land to appear, but it is difficult.
Of course, there are also those who are very lucky. The novice territory is a forest, or a mineral vein, etc. These belong to the chosen ones. Such existences develop faster than others from the beginning.
